title: CollabAtlas Dataset Entry
description: Schema for validating dataset entries in the CollabAtlas collaborative solutions knowledge platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the entry, lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

tagline.description: Short summary of the dataset, max 200 characters.

domains.description: Domains or fields where this dataset is relevant.

collaboration-types.description: Types of collaboration this dataset relates to.

scales.description: Scales at which this dataset is applicable.

external_links.description: External links related to the dataset.

related_entries.description: IDs of related entries in the atlas.

created.description: Date the entry was created (ISO 8601 date).

last_reviewed.description: Date the entry was last reviewed (ISO 8601 date).

contributors.description: List of contributors who authored or reviewed this entry.

research_methods.description: Research methods associated with this dataset.

source_url.description: URL where the dataset can be accessed or downloaded.

doi.description: DOI associated with the dataset record when available.

format.description: File format of the dataset (e.g., CSV, JSON, Parquet).

size.description: Size of the dataset (e.g., '2.5 GB', '10,000 records').

license.description: License under which the dataset is distributed.

temporal_coverage.description: Time period covered by the dataset (e.g., '2015-2023').

platform_id.description: Platform-specific identifier (e.g., Zenodo DOI, Kaggle slug, Figshare article ID).

version.description: Dataset version when provided by the hosting platform.

source_services.description: External services used to enrich or import the dataset metadata.

fetched_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last automatic enrichment refresh.

github_repo.description: GitHub repository in owner/repo form when the dataset was enriched from GitHub.

visibility.description: Repository visibility reported by GitHub when available.

metrics.description: Activity metrics from the source repository.
